standard-dialogue.player: Why do you keep killing boars?

standard-dialogue.npc: Because they drop bones which I am going to use to train my prayer. The meat is also a nice addition.

standard-dialogue.player: Wouldn't it be best to go steal cakes for food?

standard-dialogue.npc: And then go to Wintertodt? I do that every time I make an Iron person account. About time I try something new.

standard-dialogue.player: Are you at least killing the boars on task?

standard-dialogue.npc: No, maybe I should go get a slayer task now you mention it. Thanks for the reminder.

standard-dialogue-when-attempting-to-tra.npc: You can only trade with people in your group.
